$comment: Five lenses carousel, slide 1 of 6 (hook). One orb travels along one thread across all six slides.
headline: One sky. Five ways of reading it.
subhead: Swipe through the traditions Plutto speaks.

$comment: Slide 2: Vedic (North Indian chart, the orb in the first house).
headline: Vedic, for exactness.
body: Parashara's tradition reads the sidereal sky, house by house, and times your chart's periods with dashas.

$comment: Slide 3: Western (wheel with unequal houses, the orb at the centre).
headline: Western, for psychology.
body: Ptolemy's line reads the tropical zodiac and twelve houses as a map of temperament.

$comment: Slide 4: Chinese (the five elements: generating circle, controlling star).
headline: Chinese, for the elements.
body: BaZi reads your birth as four pillars of wood, fire, earth, metal and water.

$comment: Slide 5: KP (27 lunar mansions, each split into nine unequal sub-lords).
headline: KP, for the finer divisions.
body: The Krishnamurti school splits each of 27 lunar mansions into nine unequal parts, each with its own lord.

$comment: Slide 6: numerology, and the call to action.
headline: Numerology, for measuring a name.
body: Every letter has a number. P-L-U-T-T-O adds up to 23, and 2 + 3 is 5.
